failure_cases.title: The Arsenic Discovery in the Forest
failure_cases.failure_mode: High Drama with Low Standalone Context
failure_cases.why_it_failed: Contains intense confrontation between Alexander and Juliana regarding Duchess's arsenic poisoning. While dramatic, a cold viewer on TikTok lacks context for 'the Dowager Duchess' or why Juliana possessed the vial, causing confusion.
failure_cases.how_system_identified_it: Narrative Engine standalone comprehensibility check flagged specialized lore keywords ('arsenic', 'antidote', 'Dowager') and penalized score by 10 points.
failure_cases.remediation_suggestion: Add on-screen premise text overlay: 'She infiltrated the manor to find the poison...', or reserve this clip for Day 4 retargeting ads.

failure_cases.title: Midnight Blood & Hearthside Vulnerability
failure_cases.why_it_failed: The second half contains an extraordinary emotional confession. However, the first 6 seconds are quiet action (washing a bloody basin) without spoken dialogue. In vertical video, 70% of viewers scroll past within 2 seconds of silence.
failure_cases.how_system_identified_it: First-3-Seconds Analyzer detected no spoken dialogue until 00:06.50, triggering the 'Slow Atmospheric Setup' penalty.
failure_cases.remediation_suggestion: Adjust start timestamp forward by +5.5 seconds to open directly on Juliana's gasp and Alexander's first spoken line.

failure_cases.title: Bandaging Torn Hands by the Hearth
failure_cases.why_it_failed: Shows Alexander tenderly tending to Juliana's hands after the blackthorn ordeal. While emotionally resonant, it ends on a soothing, resolved embrace. The viewer feels satisfied and has low urgency to watch the next episode.
failure_cases.how_system_identified_it: Cliffhanger detector found neither sound FX cliffhanger, cut to black, nor unanswered question, applying the 'Weak Unresolved Ending' penalty.
failure_cases.remediation_suggestion: Trim 10 seconds earlier to cut on Alexander's vow 'No one will ever hurt you again' while Juliana's face remains full of dread.

failure_cases.title: Extreme 30-Episode Leap (Altar to Dungeon)
failure_cases.why_it_failed: An algorithm generating cross-episode clips paired Juliana at the altar with Juliana in dungeon chains. While contrast is high, the sudden transition without showing her marriage or infiltration leaves viewers disoriented.
failure_cases.how_system_identified_it: Narrative transition coherence filter rejected the pair because character states jumped 4 story arcs without causal bridging.
failure_cases.remediation_suggestion: Only permit cross-episode cuts between arcs with direct causal or revenge continuity (e.g., Altar Abandonment Ep 1 -> Cathedral Revenge Ep 42).
